full_prompt_en: The image is a square antique-looking illustrated group portrait of six somber men in dark period clothing. A warm cream ground carries delicate tan scrollwork along the upper edge and around the sides, like the decorative border of an old print. The figures are arranged in overlapping tiers with almost no empty space between their shoulders. Three stand across the upper row: at left a dark-haired man with tall swept hair and a narrow mustache faces left in a high pale collar; at center a black-haired man with a thick mustache looks straight ahead from a broad black coat; at right a curly-haired man turns toward the right in a high burgundy collar. Below them, an older gray-haired man in brown and rust faces down toward the right. A smaller mustached figure in a dark hat stands at lower left beside a pale skull. The frontmost central man wears a rounded dark hat and a heavy black fur-like cape, with a curled mustache and direct gaze. Their coats form a connected wedge of charcoal, umber, and russet across the lower two thirds, while the pale faces and collars create a scattered rhythm of light. The drawing uses fine brown ink-like contours and small directional hatch marks for hair, cloth, wrinkles, and ornament. Muted watercolor or print-like color fills the shapes with slight grain and worn cream paper visible between marks. Light is soft and even, giving the faces clear tonal modeling but no strong cast shadows. The viewpoint is frontal at bust height, emphasizing heads, collars, and layered silhouettes over any physical setting. The whole composition reads as a crowded historical character plate, balanced by its restrained palette, decorative border, and carefully varied poses.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、带古旧气息的插画群像：六名神情凝重的男子穿着深色旧式衣装。暖奶油色底面沿上边和两侧带纤细赭棕卷草纹，像旧印刷品的装饰边框。人物分层交叠排开，肩膀之间几乎没有空隙。上排三人：左侧深发、高高后梳头发的男子留细长胡须，穿高浅领朝左；中央黑发、浓胡须男子从宽大的黑大衣中直视前方；右侧卷发男子穿高酒红领，向右转头。其下，一位灰发年长男子穿棕与锈色衣服，向右下低头。左下较小的戴暗帽胡须人物立在一只浅色骷髅旁。最靠前的中央男子戴圆暗帽、披厚重黑色毛皮状斗篷，卷胡须，直视观者。大衣在下方三分之二连成炭黑、棕褐与锈红的楔形，浅脸和领口形成散落的亮色节奏。细棕色墨线式轮廓和顺向小排线描出头发、布料、皱纹与装饰。低饱和水彩或印刷式颜色填入形状，带轻微颗粒，磨旧奶油色纸面从笔痕间露出。光柔和而均匀，使面孔有清楚的明暗塑形，却没有强烈投影。视点从胸像高度正看，强调头部、衣领和层叠剪影，而非实体环境。整幅构图像拥挤的历史人物图版，克制色盘、装饰边框与各异姿态使它保持平衡。
style_prompt_en: Antique-looking illustration combines precise brown ink contours, tight directional hatching, and restrained watercolor-like fills on warm cream paper. Deep charcoal and umber shapes overlap in a compact tiered arrangement, with russet and burgundy accents interrupting the dark field. Pale openings appear in small separated patches and create the main light rhythm. Fine scrolling ornament frames the denser central forms without becoming a hard graphic border. Edges are carefully drawn yet softened by grain, uneven print density, and exposed paper tone. Illumination is diffuse, allowing subtle tonal volume in focal areas while broad dark masses stay comparatively flat. The image feels crowded, theatrical, and archival through layered silhouettes and patient small marks.
style_prompt_zh: 古旧气息的插画把准确的棕墨轮廓、紧密顺向排线与克制的水彩式填色放在暖奶油色纸面上。深炭色与棕褐形状在紧凑的分层布局中交叠，锈红与酒红点缀打断暗场。浅色开口以分散的小片出现，形成主要亮色节奏。细卷草装饰围住较密的中央形体，又不变成坚硬的图形框。边缘经过仔细描画，却被颗粒、不均印墨密度和露出的纸色柔化。漫散光让焦点区域有细微立体感，宽阔暗块则相对平面。层叠剪影与耐心的小记号令图像显得拥挤、戏剧化且像旧档案。
theme_en: An ensemble of six somber men in dark period clothing
theme_zh: 六名身着深色旧式衣装的神情凝重男子
name: What We Do In The Shadows
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
